arguments.command:
@'
import json, tempfile, os
from hone.hone import Hone
from hone.utils import parse_json_file, parse_csv_file
root = r"tests/fixtures/data_file"
h = Hone()
# E1 comma
for name in ["comma_test","quotes_test","small_cats_dataset"]:
    csv = os.path.join(root,name,"dataset.csv")
    exp = parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,name,"nested_dataset.json"))
    got = h.convert(csv)
    print(name, "golden", got == exp)
# E3 schema + get_schema
csv = os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","dataset.csv")
sch = parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","nested_schema.json"))
print("E3 schema convert", h.convert(csv, schema=sch) == parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","nested_dataset.json")))
print("E3 get_schema", h.get_schema(csv) == sch)
# E21 mixed schema: missing column omitted, unreferenced dropped, JSON string schema
schema = {"name":"name","birth":{"day":"birth day"},"missing":"nope"}
print("E21 dict", Hone().convert(csv, schema=schema)[0])
print("E21 jsonstr", Hone().convert(csv, schema=json.dumps(schema))[0] == Hone().convert(csv, schema=schema)[0])
# E14 utils
print("E14 parse_csv_file", [len(parse_csv_file(os.path.join(root,n,"dataset.csv"))[0]) for n in ["comma_test","quotes_test","small_cats_dataset"]])
'@ | python -
